description: This file defines a ResultSet class for 'Project' entities within the Coocook schema, providing methods for querying projects such as finding by URL name, filtering non-archived projects, public projects, and identifying stale (past) projects based on date comparisons.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Project
classes.description: A ResultSet class for handling collections of 'Project' records, with methods for sorting, filtering, and identifying stale projects.

methods.name: sorted_by_columns
methods.description: Returns the columns used for default sorting of projects, namely 'url_name_fc' and 'name'.

methods.name: find_by_url_name
methods.description: Finds a project record by its URL name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: not_archived
methods.description: Returns a result set of projects that are not archived.

methods.name: public
methods.description: Returns a result set of projects marked as public.

methods.name: stale
methods.description: Returns a result set of projects that are entirely in the past based on associated 'meals' and 'purchase_lists' dates, indicating they can be archived.
